tasks.name: Audit PatientCreationModal.tsx for fast emergency booking, zero blocking fields (SNILS, passport, OMS/DMS optional)
Audit NewAppointmentForm.tsx for 15-second acute pain booking (name + phone only), no assistant required
Audit useChairScheduleState.ts, ScheduleFilterStrip.tsx & visit status transitions (Scheduled -> Arrived -> In chair -> Completed)
Audit WaitlistQuickFillModal.tsx (1968 lines) for fast slot filling from waitlist
Run schedule tests and take/view schedule screenshots via view_file

findings.summary: Type-only import of React ('import type React from "react"') caused ReferenceError: React is not defined during JSX evaluation.

Silent phantom waitlist fulfillment: when chairs array was empty or doctor unselected, appointment creation was skipped, yet waitlist entry was marked fulfilled (PUT /api/waitlist/:id) with false success toast.
Overbooking & CITO 409 rejection: 'Записать CITO (Острая боль / Овербукинг)' called createAppointmentFromDraft() with no arguments, omitting allowOverbooking and failing on resource collisions.
Mixed query phone loss & closure race: search string like 'Иван +79991234567' lost phone number; React state update race triggered 'выберите пациента' validation error before state propagated.
CITO emergency Enter blocking: empty name triggered validation error in emergency mode, disabling Enter key submission in phone field.

fixes.summary: Fixed React import, added solo chair fallback (DEFAULT_SOLO_CHAIR.id) and doctor fallback, added allowOverbooking: true to POST /api/appointments, prevented phantom waitlist fulfillment on failure or empty slot.

Updated createAppointmentFromDraft prop type to accept options, passed { allowOverbooking: isCitoOrOverbook, allowEmergencyOverride: isCitoOrOverbook }, parsed phone and name from mixed queries, mutated draft patientId synchronously.
Exempted emergency/CITO draft from mandatory fullName error, allowing auto-default to 'Пациент с острой болью (CITO)'.
Provided explicit warning toast when Enter is pressed with missing required fields in non-CITO mode.
Added 7 targeted unit tests proving solo chair fallback, mixed phone parsing, overbooking detection, and CITO emergency validation.
